content: 12:1-11 Qenu Igomurur mi banam wes-wes ar indab igo end Pol qamarei
Io, an yonou munon banam, Igomurur qau mi banam ar indab igo eng an at qangangetorunon.
Qoan an Yisas me imbig igamau qen end munon qei der wurinou aibigau qob qamarau ue eng qugur barsi wogub ansesimari orotoar qib igumanei.

End ne an imbigar: Qenu wonou Igomurur qau munon ger boopuri ten igama eng munon eng ete at me qamb igo: “Yisas eng uburiba” ende me qamb igo. Ne gor, Igomurur qau me opuri igoriner eng ete gor at me qemerinerei: “Yisas wo ininou Munon Barai,” ende gor me qemerinerei.
Igomurur qau git gari qas eng mi wes-wes banam ar indab igo.
End ne Munon Aib wonou sarau wes-wes ebet igoun? Eng Munon Aib git gari qas eng wonou sarau werei wes-wes at beau eng.
Qenu git gari qas eng munon wurinonogursia ne wonou sarau wes-wes baab igour.
Ne Igomurur munon gari-gari wurinonogursi igo eng wuri bo imusi munon gugum wurinonogursiarar qamb.
Munon ger Igomurur oau menima misir uber igub munon wurinob qamb igo. Ne ger nonogursia Qenu wonou qob werei eng qamara munon yamangar Qenu imbig igour.
Ne Igomurur gari eng munon ger oau bea wot oabig igo. Ne Igomurur gari eng munon ger opuri igama munon toar igara wurimusub igo.

Ne munon ger nonogursia qomon qiribiten ger ebet igo, ne ger Qenu wonou qob eng imbiga musub dibes qamb igo. Ne ger imbiga munon wurinou misir song-song eng wuriqerei imbig igo. Ne ger munon qob wes-wes eng imbiga qoyamet igo. Ne ger imbiga munon ger qob wes-wes eng qemeriner eng igub qanam dibes qamara munon qei imbig igour.
Mi eng gagar gugum Igomurur gari qas eng wonou munon gari-gari mi wes-wes banam ar wurisab igo.
12:12-31 In gitgoan gari qas eng unum wes-wes igo
Munon inubersiau tari eng wo git goan gari qas igo. Eng unum wes-wes igo eng gugum qiumuni git goan gari qas.

Eng gas ende sig, Yuda munon ne munon ar ne munon unebi boru eng ne munon uber eng gugum Igomurur gari qas eng gab-gab yat inmaragansiari git goan gari qas bureminei. End qogum gari qas end ya erogori nub igoruboun.
In git goan git gari qas ego unum wes-wes igo.
End ne goten der ete qemeriner eng: “ye uben igo gab end ye git goan ue.” Ende qamara gab eng an wo qob eng me igatatar. Eng wo ar ai qorut me igo, wo git goan end iyet igo.
Ne bo iruges ete at qemeriner eng: “ye mag igo gab end ye git goan ue.” Ende qamara gab eng gor qob me igatatar, wo gor git goan end iyet igo.
End ne in git goan gugum mag qur qas igama eng maigas mi toau iguboun? Ne gor git goan gugum iruges qas igama eng mi qogom maigas imbigiboun?
Ue ar, Qenu wonou imbig ne git goan tau wes-wes barsier eng git goan gari end iyet igour.
End ne git goan saranang ar igama eng in maigas git goan imbiguboun?
End git goan tau wes-wes end goan gari end iyet igour.
End ne mag qur der uben nob agunub ete me qemeriner: “Ye ne me neqenungoum.” Ne gor tari der gotent: “Yonou gari uber igoum, ne me neqenungoum.”
Ende ue, git goan tau qei ue igoriner eng git goan gugum uber me igorinerei.
Git goan qei bais boru qamb wotumet igoun eng wo sig-sig mom git betet igoun.
Qenu git goan gugum barsier end qeemben igour. Ne git goan gari-gari siningot igoun eng wuri git goan aib eng aba sarog big igo.
Ende aba ne git goan gugum purab tau-tau me isar qamb. Erogori git goan gari qas qeemben igour.
End ne git goan eret uter wara eng git goan gugum quguraget igour. A gugum uber igo eng gugum mismisir igour.
An gugum Munon inubersiau tari eng wonou git goan gari. Wonou git goan igeragart eng an git goan eng.

Qenu munon yurau wonou sarau abar qamb wurimaribigor eng: Qamar wonou munon yurau wuriimuriamor eng. Ne yab wonou qob qamarar qamb wurimaribigor eng, ne bo imbigau munon wurimaribigorei. Eng imusi munon yurau qomon qiribiten abari dibent igo eng. Ne bo eng imusi toar musub igour yurau eng. Ne bo eng imusi munon ar qibanamsiau eng, ne bo munon sarau aib qoat igamau eng, ne qob mindiram goten wes-wes qamarau eng, ende.
Munon yurau eng wuri gugum mai, wuriimurimau yurau eng sori igo qiyo, a qob dibes qamarau eng gari igo qiyo, a imbigau munon gari igo qiyo. A qomon wes abau eng gari igo qiyo?
Qo toar munon wurimusiau eng gari igo qiyo? A qob weswes qamarau eng gari igo qiyo, a qob qanam eng musub dibes qamarau eng gari igo eng, mai obouboun?
End an musub imbig qerei ne mi uber-uber ar banam indab igo eng gab toat igoarar. End ne ye qomon ger sig uber eng an toat igoarar qamb aninob qemeribam eng.
